Questions, answered

Why is it so cheap?arrow_forward

We're at launch pricing while we grow. Early subscribers lock in this rate forever — even as we add bigger features like image-seeded AI music and longer clips.

What payment methods do you accept?arrow_forward

Card payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit/debit) through Whop. Cancel anytime from your Whop dashboard.

Can I cancel anytime?arrow_forward

Yes. Cancel from your Whop dashboard and you'll stay PRO until the end of your billing period, then return to the free plan — no questions asked.

What if a download fails or a copyright check is wrong?arrow_forward

Free users see an error. PRO members get a one-click retry plus a Report button — our team re-runs the job by hand and emails you when it works.

Will free features get removed if I don’t upgrade?arrow_forward

Never. The free plan stays free and keeps the copyright checker, library browsing, and 2 daily MP3 downloads. PRO adds creator tools on top.

How do refunds work?arrow_forward

If PRO doesn’t work for you, we refund your last billed month — even on day 29. See our refund policy for details.
